item.title: UK tribunal rules 5% VAT should apply to public EV charging
item.description: First-tier Tribunal backs reduced 5 per cent VAT rate.Ruling could lower costs for public EV charging users.HMRC reviewing decision and considering next steps. item.description: IRAN was hit with another wave of strikes on Sunday, a day after the killing of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei in US and Israeli attacks.
